description: Reviewed from Cape Wickham Golf Links on King Island, Tasmania. The donor contains no placed tree population, so it is retained only as reference analysis and is intentionally excluded from the Beta 5 Regional Theme selector.

reference_context.real_world_region: Cape Wickham / King Island / Bass Strait, Tasmania, Australia

calibration_notes: The donor contains no placed tree objects; this is treated as intentional for a pure exposed links environment rather than as a failed specimen-tree calibration.
The real Cape Wickham landscape is windswept dunes, fescue, coastal heath/scrub and spray-zone vegetation rather than a tree-dominated golf landscape.
tree_generation=none suppresses automatic LiDAR/OSM tree prefab generation for this regional theme instead of inventing a false tree palette.

The donor uses Designer theme 15 (Highlands). All surfaces2 and secondarySurfaces slots are unnamed theme defaults, so applying the root Highlands theme is essential to reproducing the donor environment.
Future coastal-heath/massing support should model low scrub, pigface, coastal grasses and other Bass Strait vegetation separately from the specimen-tree system.
